correctness.rationale: The source supplies a finite good triangulation of every compact smooth orbifold coarse space and the rank formula \(4\gcd(4,e_5(M))\). In top degree, each codimension-one simplex of that triangulation has either two coarse top cofaces, giving a relation \(x_i=\pm x_j\), or one coface at a reflection wall, giving \(x_i=0\). Componentwise reduction of these relations yields only \(\mathbb Z\), \(\mathbb Z/2\), or zero summands, so the 2-primary exponent is at most \(2\). The free-point connected-sum lower example preserves the source's embedded mapping-torus obstruction and its rank-four bundle glues across the ordinary sphere boundary.
